successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Brakna, the southern Mauritanian emirate north of the Senegal river round Aleg (the page names no town or river; the gazetteer's Brakna region stands for it)

ledger.x: After 1677: the Brakna emirate is founded.
1902: the independent emirate ends under the protectorate; the page gives no end date.

wars.name: Brakna-Trarza war
wars.outcome: "Brakna and Trarza fought a war from 1720-22 competing to obtain influence in the kingdoms of Waalo and Futa Toro."

wars.name: Futa Toro revolution of Abdul Kader
wars.outcome: Under Emir Hamet Mokhtar the Brakna allied with Abdul Kader "during his revolution that established the Imamate of Futa Toro".

certainty.note: The page gives only 'southern Mauritania'; the Brakna region is a stand-in.
